ideas.title: Following the Money in the Minnesota Somali Fraud Case
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged fraud involving Somali individuals in Minnesota and follow the money trail to determine where the $19B went
questions: Who was involved in the alleged fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and shed light on the use of public funds. By following the money trail, we may be able to identify key players and determine the extent of the alleged fraud.
